content.thinking:

Looking at my available tools, I only have `send_message` which posts a message into the channel. I don't have any tools to look up deals, search CRM data, or read files related to a specific deal.

arguments.text: Hey Mike — I don't have visibility into deal records or pipeline data, so I can't pull up the current status on Umbrella. Could you check it in the CRM directly, or ask someone on the deal team for the latest update? I'm happy to help summarize once you've got the details.
